system.text:
Troll Skin is resilient and leathery. It provides 1D of armor to the limbs and head, 2D to the chest. As he gets older, a Troll’s flesh often hardens into a stony mass. Thus, the Troll Skin trait maybe upgraded to Scaly Skin or Stone Skin for just a few trait points. See the Troll Special Traits list. This skin cannot “fail” and become damaged like armor: 1s are discounted in this case. VA works as normal against this armor.

Type: Dt. Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Troll common trait

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 531
